```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
library(randomForest)
```

```{r analysis}
# Read in data
rf_dat <- read_csv("rf_dat.csv")

# Random forest model 
set.seed(123)
rf_model <- randomForest(
  response ~ .,
  data = rf_dat,
  mtry = 2,
  ntree = 1000,
  importance = TRUE
)

# Save predictions
rf_dat$predictions <- predict(rf_model, newdata = rf_dat)

# Plot variable importance
varImpPlot(rf_model)

#Plot predicted vs. actual values
ggplot(rf_dat, aes(x = response, y = predictions)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0,
               linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  labs(
    title = "Actual vs. Predicted Response",
    x = "Actual Response",
    y = "Predicted Response"
  ) +
  theme_classic()
```
